B1.name: Vidhi
prescription: Weakness: Multivitamin with B-Complex, 1 tablet daily after lunch

B2.name: Aman Verma
prescription: Burn: Silver Sulfadiazine cream, apply thick layer on clean burn area
Dizziness: ORS solution + Cinnarizine 25mg if motion sickness related

B3.name: Rohan Das
prescription: Stomach pain: Dicyclomine 20mg, take 1 tablet when severe pain occurs
Vomiting: Ondansetron 4mg, 1 tablet 30 minutes before meal

B4.name: Pooja Nair
prescription: Cold: Cetirizine 10mg, 1 tablet at night before sleeping
Headache: Ibuprofen 400mg, 1 tablet after food as needed

B5.name: Siddharth Jain
prescription: Minor cut: Wash with clean water, apply Povidone-Iodine cream and bandage
Body pain: Aceclofenac 100mg, 1 tablet twice daily after food

B6.name: Sahaskrit
prescription: Sore Throat: Betadine gargle solution diluted with warm water twice daily
Weakness: Multivitamin with B-Complex, 1 tablet daily after lunch
Dizziness: ORS solution + Cinnarizine 25mg if motion sickness related
